public_rationale: Using the stipulated $2.7 billion annualized ChatGPT baseline, an unchanged revenue mix provides a counterexample: preserving the September 2024 forecast share of $2.7 billion out of $3.7 billion gives $8.465 billion in ChatGPT revenue toward the $11.6 billion 2025 target [e1, e2, e3]. Assuming those rates hold throughout 2025, the required increase is 213.5%, with the final amount equal to 313.5% of the baseline [e3]. This scenario reaches the total target with less than 310% ChatGPT growth, contradicting the claimed necessity [e3].
limitations: The reported $2.7 billion figure was a 2024 annual forecast; it does not verify a $225 million monthly run rate [e1].
The calculation assumes an unchanged revenue mix and a full year at the resulting rates. It does not establish actual 2025 revenue or the feasibility of sustaining those rates [e3].
The financial premises come from reporting rather than directly available private financial documents [e1, e2, e3].
